Title: Osney Bridge diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath closed about 150 yards from bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road.

Title: Marsh Lock Footbridge closure Henley
Description: Footbridge closed for safety. 3-mile diversion via A4155 pavements between Henley and Shiplake. Order active until 31 January 2026 (likely extended).

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge north (upstream) of Sandford Lock closed. Diversion via NCN 5.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Walkway closed due to corrosion. Rerouted via Abingdon town centre. Closes when river levels rise or weir gates operate.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure Marlow
Description: Closed May 2023 due to structural damage. Central span removed Nov 2025. Unlikely to reopen until 2028. Diversion via Marlow Bridge and Bisham.

Title: Bridge 142 closure Egham
Description: Footbridge closed Feb 2024 for safety. Structural damage. 0.6-mile diversion via A308 pavements.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion around construction compound at Runnymede Pleasure Ground for Bell Weir refurbishment works. Spring 2026 to autumn 2027.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: 0.5-mile diversion south of Streatley due to eroding towpath. Unlikely to reopen until late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public due to diseased trees (ash dieback). Thames Path itself unaffected.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Closed March 2024 due to structural and safety concerns. Follow-up specialist survey completed.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between River Brent bridge and Brentford Marina. Area being redeveloped.
